patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Neutralizes Smart Launcher's internal anti-tamper signature verification to prevent instant shutdown on launch.

patches.name: Contextual app menu actions
patches.description: Adds a dedicated Archive App entry into the long-press popup menu.

patches.name: Hide archived apps
patches.description: Filters archived apps out of the app drawer.

patches.name: Morphe settings UI integration
patches.description: Integrates the Morphe Patches & App Archiving settings panel into Smart Launcher Settings (under Dev options / Experimental features).

patches.name: Native app archiving
patches.description: Enables system PackageInstaller/LauncherApps native archiving runtime on Android 15+ / One UI 7.

patches.name: Shizuku app archiving
patches.description: Enables Shizuku binder-level privileged app archiving execution in Smart Launcher 6.
